jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Carbon and Environmental Models (all genders)
jobs.description:
The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and we turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it.

We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact.
 
 Your mission: 
 Lead a cross functional team of Soil Scientists and Software Engineers to develop and implement SOC models as the foundation of Klim’s platform

 Own and drive the product roadmap for carbon, biodiversity, and broader soil science and agronomic models

 Expand Klim’s modelling capabilities beyond carbon into crop and agronomic insights, and over time into economic models such as farm level P&L

 Contribute to the commercial scalability of Klim’s solutions and support large scale decarbonisation of agricultural supply chains

 
 Your responsibilities: 
 1. Product Definition and Delivery 
 Translate scientific models into clear product requirements and features

 Align modelling work with product and company goals

 Drive execution from concept to production

 Develop a strong understanding of underlying models to effectively guide product decisions and challenge assumptions

 2. Model Development, Carbon and Beyond 
 Improve accuracy and scalability of carbon models as the core system

 Expand models to include agronomic metrics, new practices, and new geographies

 Identify and prioritise additional soil science or environmental metrics

 3. Compliance and Scientific Integrity 
 Ensure alignment with key standards such as VERRA VM0042, GHG Protocol, SustainCERT, SAI RTF and ISOMETRIC

 Work with internal and external stakeholders to maintain compliance and scientific credibility

 4. Team Leadership and Execution 
 Lead and prioritise the work of a cross functional team of scientists and engineers

 Ensure effective collaboration between scientific development and product implementation

 Create clarity on priorities and trade offs

 5. Cross Functional Alignment 
 Partner with MRV to ensure models meet regulatory requirements

 Collaborate with Farmer Sales to ensure consistency with field data

 Align with other product teams to integrate models into the platform

 Incorporate client and market insights into product decisions to maximise commercial impact

 
 Your profile: 
 Product and Execution Skills 
 3 to 6 years of product management experience , ideally in data/scientific heavy or technical products

 Proven track record of shipping products end to end

 Experience running development cycles and sprints

 Strong prioritization and problem solving

 Ability to operate effectively in a fast changing environment with evolving requirements and constraints

 Strategic and Commercial Thinking 
 Ability to shape short to long term product strategy

 Prioritise features based on impact, feasibility, and regulatory constraints

 Adapt to evolving regulations and markets

 Stakeholder Management 
 Translate complex technical topics for non technical audiences

 Align multiple stakeholders across functions

 Strong communication skills

 Technical Understanding 
 Strong ability to understand complex models at a high level, including their assumptions, limitations, and implications for product decisions

 Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as physics, engineering, environmental science, mathematics, or similar is a strong plus

 High attention to detail and rigor when working with data, models, and assumptions

 Able to quickly learn and reason about new technical domains

 Languages 
 English required

 German is a plus but not a requirement

 
 Your benefits: 
 Opportunity : Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

 Impact : Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

 Autonomy : Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

 Flexible work model : At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.

As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area. 

Who We Want 

Hungry learner
You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months.

Structured self-starter
You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance.

Analytical thinker
You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights.

Customer-curious
You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways.

Clear communicator
You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars.

Scrappy generalist
You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you".

AI-native
You use AI tools daily to work faster and better - from research and data analysis to drafting content and slides - and you're always experimenting with new ones.

Has taste
You have a strong sense for what good looks like in product, design and writing, and you notice when something feels off, even if it's "technically fine".

Language
You're fluent in English, written and spoken.

Who We Don't Want 

  • You only want "pure PM" work like roadmaps and specs and aren't interested in marketing or customer-facing tasks
  • You need a lot of structure and clear processes to be productive
  • You struggle to communicate clearly in English, in writing or in front of an audience
  • You get defensive when receiving feedback
  • You see this mainly as a title step rather than a chance to learn and get hands-on

Your Day to Day 

Strategic Projects (~25%)

  • Work directly with our CPO on the topics that matter most right now
  • Prepare leadership meetings, drive decisions forward and make sure priorities turn into results

Product Marketing & Launches (~35%)

  • Plan and run initiatives that bring our product to customers: webinars, product updates, customer events, newsletters and educational content
  • Prepare and launch new features end-to-end together with Product, Engineering and Marke

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Kernel
 Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?
 
 Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.
 
 Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.
 
 Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at  Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout  already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.
 
 We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 12x YoY .
 
 The role 
 You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team

jobs.title: Product Manager - Preclinical Device
jobs.description:
Location : London, with occasional travel. 
  
 About Netholabs
 Netholabs builds large-scale neural and behavioural recording platforms to generate the data needed for the next generation of brain models. We operate two recording platforms: a preclinical ethological monitoring system integrated with behaviour and neural data and a human motion-capture and neurophysiology platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where hardware, neuroscience, and ML sit in the same room.
  
 The Role
 We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection. Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.
 You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.
  
 What you'll do
 Take working prototypes to shippable, field-deployable systems — define the product, own the roadmap, and drive it to delivery

 Specify and build out over-the-air update infrastructure: firmware, versioning, rollback, fleet management, remote diagnostics

 Own the design-for-manufacture transition — DFM/DFA reviews, BOM ownership, tolerancing, test fixtures, and production test protocols

 Identify, qualify, and manage contract manufacturers and suppliers; own the relationship from RFQ through NPI to sustained production

 Establish and enforce best-practice data capture protocols across modalities (EEG, fNIRS, EMG, pupillometry, motion capture, video) so that data quality is consistent across sessions, operators, and sites

 Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation

 Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirements — and push back when a requirement doesn't survive contact with manufacturing

 Build the quality, documentation, and regulatory groundwork (design history, ISO 13485-style discipline, CE/UKCA pathway) appropriate to a research-device product

 Contribute to the industrialisation of our rodent recording platform where the manufacturing and OTA problems overlap
  

 What we're looking for
 Essential
 Min 3+ years (ideal 7+) in hardware product management, product engineering, or programme management, with several products you personally took from prototype to volume manufacture 

 Direct, demonstrable experience with contract manufacturers: you have run RFQs, sat through NPI builds, argued about yield, and fixed a production line problem from 6,000 miles away

 Deep understanding of connected-device architecture: OTA update mechanisms, device provisioning, telemetry, fleet management, and what it costs to get these wrong

 Fluency across electronics, mechanical, and firmware enough to hold a real technical conversation with each - you don't need to design the board, but you need to know when the answer you're getting is wrong

 Track record of writing specifications and protocols that people actually follow

 Comfort with ambiguity and a small-company reality: no PMO, no roadmap tooling team, no one to delegate the boring parts to

 Strongly preferred 
 Experience with wearable, biosignal, or medical device hardware

 Familiarity with human research data collection — protocols, participant handling, IRB/ethics, GDPR and special-category data

 Experience shipping a product to CE/UKCA or FDA pathway

 Background in neuroscience, biomedical engineering, or a related field

 Experience with multi-sensor time synchronisation and the data infrastructure behind it

 What we offer
 Direct ownership of a product line at a company small enough that your decisions ship

 Equity in an early-stage company building foundational infrastructure for brain modelling

 A team of neuroscientists and engineers doing genuinely novel work

 Central London lab, on-site, with access to the Sussex rodent facility

 To apply: send a CV and a short note about a product you took from prototype to manufacture what broke, and what you did about it.

From there, you own the path to our customers and partners.
 Where a change is large enough to become a program in its own right, you own that program end to end. Other teams own their functional deliverables; you own the plan, the sequence, the cadence, the deadline, and the outcome. These programs carry hard cutoffs and significant revenue.
 This is a cross-functional program management role at its core: a lot of coordination, judgment, and real accountability for the outcome. There's no playbook waiting for you — building it is part of the job.
 Areas of ownership:
 GTM to Product & Engineering Interface: Serve as the connection point for upcoming customer-impacting changes, bringing both sides together early to align on how customers and partners are affected and what they need to do. You determine which internal teams have to be enabled, from Engagement Managers and Sales to Solution Engineering, Partnerships, and Product Marketing.

 Program Orchestration: Act as the single coordination point across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Product Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, and Engagement Managers. You steer cross-functional kickoffs, run the cadence that keeps programs moving, and hold functional owners to their commitments, including when that means escalating or re-sequencing.

 Communication Sequencing: Design the plans for customer and partner communication so they experience one coordinated channel instead of several, and collect early customer and field feedback before it becomes an escalation.

 Execution and Accountability: Track progress against plan, enforce deadlines, own escalation management end to end, and report to senior leadership in a way that makes risk visible early rather than defensible late.

 Building the Discipline: Define and measure success metrics for each program, run retrospectives that produce process change rather than documents, and build the playbooks, SOPs, and governance cadence that make this function durable.

 Who you are:
 5-7+ years in program or project management, owning complex cross-functional programs end to end — not workstreams inside someone else's program

 You've worked as the connective tissue between technical and commercial teams, translating in both directions

 Technically fluent in enterprise software platforms: you can assess what a change means for customers without Engineering explaining it each time

 You operate without formal authority — you've held teams to deadlines you don't own, and you're comfortable making the call

 You build the system, not just the tracker; you've created or fixed a process that outlived your tenure

 Energized rather than paralyzed by ambiguity; you build the playbook while running the plays

 An exceptionally strong writer, equally at home in technical detail and executive narrative

 Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser
 Why Parloa?
 We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.
 At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

jobs.description:
In just over two years, we've gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world's carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners.
 We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer to own design at Spruce: someone whose bar for craft is higher than ours, and who wants to set the standard for what our product looks and feels like as it gets more ambitious.
 
 🌲 About Spruce
 Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

 We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.

 We raised a chunky Seed round from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We're just about to launch solar and battery, and we're ultimately building the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed…

 
 🥖 The role
 Our product handles building physics, fluid dynamics modelling and compliance – and is about to do a whole lot more. The job is to make all of that quick, intuitive and even delightful for a tradesperson who wants to spend as little time as possible at their desk. We've been design-led since the beginning, but the challenge is only growing as the product becomes (necessarily) more complex. Day-to-day you'll be:
 Owning design at Spruce – Setting the design direction and standards across the product, deciding what good looks like, and building the practice (critique, tooling, rituals) that lets us keep shipping fast as the product and team grow. You'll work alongside our two product designers, raising the bar on their work as well as your own.

 Doing the hardest design work yourself – This is a hands-on role. You'll take the gnarliest flows end to end: desktop design tools, homeowner-facing outputs, enquiry flows, mobile survey apps (incl. LiDAR), and collaborative workflows that work for everyone from a 3-person local installer to a national utility.

 Collaborating closely with developers & shipping code yourself – Understanding data structures and technical constraints so your designs ship quickly; and shipping PRs yourself when it makes sense (with the support of the dev team).

 Researching and validating – Spending time with installers on site to deeply understand how they work and what the core problems are; building quick prototypes to test decisions and uncover unexpected pain points.

 You'll report directly to Steph, our Co-Founder and CPO.
 
 🫵 About you
 We're looking for a designer with 6+ years of product/UI design experience (and potentially much more) , including time as the most senior designer on a product or team – ideally in a startup or a fast-moving, impact-focussed environment. We'd love to speak with you if you have:
 Exceptional craft – You have a very high bar for UI execution and sweat the interaction details. You can point to work you'd happily put next to the best B2B products out there, and you can explain exactly why it's good.

 A point of view – You hold strong design opinions, argue for them, and change your mind when the evidence says so. You'd rather be challenged than left alone.

 Comfort in complexity – You're a clear, systematic thinker who enjoys technical detail, even in a domain that's new to you.

 User obsession – You've run research with real customers yourself, not via a research team, and you've shipped things that measurably changed how they work.

 Range – You're proactive and self-organising, happy running several projects at once and switching between strategy and pixels in the same afternoon.

 Bonus if you've worked on tools for field teams, low-tech users, or operational workflows – but absolutely not

 Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action.
 
 We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.
 
 Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.
 
 If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.
 
 What will I be doing? ‍‍ 👩‍💻👨‍💻

 Specific responsibilities will include:

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us 
 Every large industrial company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made.
 STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data.
 STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.
 The role. As a Senior Commercial Product Manager, you own a portfolio of our most important customers. You are responsible for the success of each deployment, for the value it creates for the customer, and for growing the relationship from initial pilot to organisation-wide rollout. You work directly with their C-suite and sales leadership to understand their business model, their commercial priorities, and where untapped growth potential lies across their markets, segments and accounts.
 You translate those priorities into what STRATOS delivers. You define what the solution needs to do, work with our engineers to make sure it gets built right, and bring the results back to the customer's decision-makers. You bridge two worlds: the customer's commercial reality and our product.
 Your responsibility doesn't end at go-live. You stay at the customer's side as they put the solution to work: challenging their thinking, helping them act on what the data shows, and making sure the impact is visible in their results.
 This role suits someone who wants to own outcomes rather than just recommend them. Beyond your own accounts, you help shape the direction of STRATOS – what we build, how we deploy it and how we grow.
 The roles you'll play 
 Trusted advisor to the C-suite — work directly with executive teams and sales leadership on where to play, how to win, and how to organise and steer a sales force. You are the person they call before they decide, not after.

 Owner of the customer, end to end — from first pilot to multi-country rollout, the deployment, the relationship and the results are yours. Our engineers build it; you decide what gets built and you stand behind whether it worked.

 Commercial owner of your portfolio — you are responsible for its growth: expansion into new use cases and new markets, and the judgement of when a customer is ready for more and when they are not.

 Product manager for your market — you translate what you see across your customers into our roadmap, define what gets built, and own it with engineering through to release.

 Builder of the function — you shape how STRATOS deploys and scales: the standards, the tooling and the people. Senior CPMs coach the CPMs around them.

 Who this is for. We hire for commercial judgement and the credibility to hold a room of executives. That does not come from one background, and we are open about where yours comes from.
 What we're actually looking for:
 You have owned a complex piece of work end to end — scoping it, aligning stakeholders who disagreed, delivering it, and being accountable for whether it worked. We're interested in people who ran the engagement, not only staffed it.

 You can hold your own with a commercial director who has run their business for twenty years and change their mind with evidence rather than seniority.

 You do your own analysis. You are comfortable in the data, and you'd rather check the number yourself than take it from a slide.

 You can explain something complicated to someone non-technical without making them feel stupid.

 You are genuinely interested in how industrial businesses make money — pricing, channels, sales coverage, market structure.

 You want to be somewhere your decisions are visible. At our size, the roadmap changes because of what you bring back.

 This is probably not for you if you want a defined remit, a stable set of processes, or a role where strategy and delivery are separate jobs. 
 What we offer 
 Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

 A highly competitive salary

 Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

 Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

 Private healthcare

 Pension scheme

 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

 Work from abroad

jobs.title: Commercial Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us 
 At STRATOS Technologies, we are transforming how companies make data-driven decisions. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, enabling businesses to strengthen their long-term strategies through clear and actionable insights.
 Our founders, former business and tech executives who led a $1B division at a Fortune 500 industrial company, originally built a digital twin of their enterprise to drive synchronized planning and execution. Seeing the market’s lack of such a system, they launched STRATOS in 2022 with a bold mission: to unifiy all internal and external data into a single platform.
 Today, STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.
 From commercial AI agents to embedded intelligence that supercharges lean teams, STRATOS enables businesses to achieve 10x productivity and strengthen long-term strategies through actionable insights. We are now expanding our team to accelerate our growth even further and help our customers outperform their competition
 The role. You own a piece of the relationship with one of our customers: their data, their questions, and whether the product answers them. You will do the analysis, present it to their commercial leadership, and take what you learn back to our engineers as something we should build. The difference from where you are now is that you stay with it. You see whether the recommendation worked, and when it doesn't, you're the one who fixes it.
 The roles you'll play 
 Owner of a workstream — take a defined part of the deployment end to end: the market model, the target list or the scoring logic, from first data through to something the customer's teams use every week.

 Advisor to the customer's commercial team — run working sessions with sales and commercial leadership, present your own analysis, and handle the challenge yourself. You are in the room, not behind it.

 Co-owner of the account — you share the relationship with a senior CPM and take on more of it as the year goes on, up to running a customer of your own.

 Voice of the customer in our roadmap — turn what you see in the field into what we build, and stay with it through the roadmap until it ships.

 Builder of how we work — sharpen the standards, templates and tooling that make the next deployment better than the last.

 Who this is for. Most people who do well here have one to three years behind them in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or an analytical commercial role.
 You have run a workstream yourself: not just the analysis, but the stakeholder who didn't want to give you the data and the deadline that moved.

 You are quick in data and you check your own numbers. Excel and PowerPoint are assumed; any SQL or Python is a bonus, not a requirement, and we'll teach you what you need.

 You can present to people twenty years your senior without either deferring to them or lecturing them.

 You are curious about how industrial businesses actually work — how a building-materials group reaches its customers, why a distributor behaves the way it does.

 You want more responsibility than your peers get, and you understand that comes with being the one who is wrong in public sometimes.

 This probably isn't for you if you want to specialise early, or if you'd rather be handed a defined analysis than decide what the right question is. 
 What we offer 
 Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

 A highly competitive salary

 Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

 Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

 Private healthcare

 Pension scheme

 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

 Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time

 Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available

 A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes

 Practicalities 
 London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

 Travel to some customer sites around, mostly within Europe

 German is genuinely useful here and several of our customers are German-speaking, but it is not a requirement

 The process 
 First round with our Talent Lead — 30 minutes

 Tehcncial case interview — 45 minutes

 Hiring manager interview with a senior executive - 30 minutes

 Second senior executive interview, which may include a case exercise - 30 minutes

 Final stage with our CEO - 45 minutes

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us 
 At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.
 
 The role 
 Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.
 
 You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.
 
 You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.
 
 Key responsibilities 
 Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

 Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

 Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

 Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

 Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Surveying & Mapping Drone
jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. 
 

 We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.
 

 Now we need someone to help decide what we build next. You’ll own the priorities for our data capture platform, from the aircraft to the sensors they carry. You’ll work side by side with customers in the field, Wingtra engineers and Wingtranauts across all business functions. Your job is to find the problems that matter most to our customers and turn good ideas into products people love. Inside Wingtra you’re the voice of the user. Outside you’re the voice of the product.

 Responsibilities 
 

 
 Know your customers. You spend time with survey and mapping teams in the field. You learn how they work, how they buy, what else they could use and what they still can’t do.

 
 Set the priorities. You weigh customer value, market opportunity, development effort, price and margin. Then you make a clear call on what comes next.

 
 Test ideas early. You try them with customers and engineers, learn fast and adjust.

 
 Shape the product development. You steer the capture platform: aircraft, sensors, workflows and data deliverables. You make the performance, reliability and usability trade-offs together with engineering.

 
 Take it to market. You launch with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and partners and explain why the product matters. After launch you stay close to field results and keep supporting the product through its lifecycle.

 
 Follow the outcomes. You track customer outcomes, usage and commercial results. You use what you learn to pick the next problem to solve with the team.

 Requirements 
 

 
 You have a taste for great products and a relentless drive to understand what makes users love them.

 
 You make things happen. You act like an owner and hold yourself accountable to outcomes not output. You care primarily about happy customers and a successful business.
You bring people with you. You listen closely, speak clearly and earn trust with customers and engineers, including when you disagree.

 
 You find a way forward. You are very comfortable with ambiguity. You work constructively with people and constraints, know when to push and when to adapt.

 
 You’ve spent 3+ years developing or deploying hardware products and their software workflows, with clear ownership of product, operational or commercial results.

 
 You have a technical background in engineering, geospatial or another technical field.

 
 You’re commercially fluent. You read a pricing model, channel margin or renewal term and see why the business cares.

 
 You’re fluent in English and happy to travel regularly to customers and partners in the US and Europe.

 Plus 
 

 
 You’ve founded a relevant business of your own, led surveying or drone operations, or built products for geospatial customers.

 
 You have hands-on experience with photogrammetry, LiDAR or bringing a commercial robotics product to market.

 If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product 
 
 Preferred starting date: ASAP
 Weekly availability: Full-time (40 hours/week)
 Location: Delft, the Netherlands (hybrid
 Report to: CEO

 
 About the company 
 Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.
 Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.
 We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.
 
 Your role 
 As Head of Product, you own our product hands-on. You are the bridge between what the market and our operators need and what we build, turning field feedback and market insight into a clear roadmap and products people actually want to use. You own how our capabilities become real products: how they are shaped, packaged, priced, taken to market, and adopted by the people who use them in the field.
 This is a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves role, not a purely strategic one. You set the product’s direction together with the founders, and you do the work to make it happen: talking to users, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to ship. You bring structure to how we do product without turning it into bureaucracy.
 You will work closely with the founders, engineering, and commercial. The company strategy is set with the founders; your job is to own the product within it and make it succeed.
 
 Your responsibilities will include 
 • Product strategy & roadmap. Owning the product roadmap and prioritization, and keeping the product direction aligned with the company strategy as the market and the technology evolve.
 • Market-to-technical bridge. Translating operator needs, market signals, and partner requirements into clear, well-scoped work for engineering, and translating technical capability back into value the market understands.
 • Hands-on product delivery. Writing requirements, shaping features, prioritizing the backlog, and working day-to-day with engineering to get things shipped and validated.
 • Product portfolio. Helping shape how our capabilities in detection, navigation, interception, and beyond fit together as a modular, scalable line-up rather than isolated tools.
 • User experience & adoption. Owning how usable our products are for end users: ease of use, onboarding, training, documentation, and the adoption path from first deployment to routine operational use.
 • Pricing & business model. Contributing to pricing, packaging, and business models across the product line-up, and owning the product side of the classic marketing mix (the 4Ps).
 • Go-to-market. Partnering with commercial and business development on go-to-market for each capability, from positioning and narrative to capability briefs and demos.
 • Market intelligence. Keeping an eye on the market: trends, competitors, adjacent opportunities, and where the next product bets should be.
 • Regulatory & compliance awareness. Given the defence context, factoring export control, procurement, and relevant standards into product decisions, working with the right internal and external stakeholders.
 • Lightweight product practices. Bringing just enough structure, process, and documentation to make product work repeatable, suited to a fast-moving deep-tech company.
 
 What you will deliver in your first year 
 • A clear, documented product roadmap, aligned with the founders and understood across the company.
 • A working feedback loop that turns field and operational insight into product decisions.
 • Well-scoped, prioritized work flowing to engineering, with product shipped and validated with users.
 • Input into pricing and business-model choices for the core product lines.
 • A joint go-to-market plan with commercial for at least one capability, taken through to execution.
 • Measurable improvement in product adoption and usability through better onboarding, documentation, and training f

About the role 
 We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.
 This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market .

 Technology & Product Narrative 
 Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

 Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

 Messaging & Positioning Framework

 Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

 Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

 Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

 Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

 Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

 Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration) 
 Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

 Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

 Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

 Cross-functional Collaboration 
 Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

 Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

 Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

 
 Who you are 
 Experience & Skills 
 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

 You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

 Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

 Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

 Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

 Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

 Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

 Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

 Fluent in English, written and spoken.

 Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

 Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

 Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

jobs.title: Senior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Ben jij de influencer-goeroe die wij zoeken?

Volg jij de nieuwste features op Instagram, TikTok, YouTube en Snapchat op de voet? Weet jij precies welke influencers op dit moment hot zijn? Beheers je zowel het Nederlands als het Engels vloeiend? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Over WPP Media

WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertisingconglomeraat. We ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.
  • Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.
  • Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.
  • Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.
  • Budgetbeheer en administratie: Je beheert projectbudgetten en houdt kosten bij, zoals influencer fees, buy-outs en event- en productiekosten. Ook verzorg je contracten en regel je boekingen met bureaus.
  • Content en kwaliteit: Je bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van alle content en deliverables, voert eerste contentchecks uit en werkt nauw samen met accountmanagers richting definitieve goedkeuring.
  • Afstemming en rapportage: Je werkt samen met interne teams om effectieve campagnes te realiseren. Je houdt klanten, stakeholders en de accountmanager proactief op de hoogte van de dagelijkse voortgang, sluit waar nodig aan bij klantupdates en rapporteert over resultaten en aandachtspunten.
  • Risicobeheersing en optimalisatie: Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en optimalisatiemogelijkheden, bespreekt deze met de (senior) accountmanager en escaleert tijdig waar nodig. Je stuurt actief bij, optimaliseert lopende campagnes en voert verbeteringen door met medior- en juniorcollega’s.
  • Evaluatie en begeleiding: Je levert inhoudelijke input voor projectevaluaties, vertaalt learnings naar verbeteringen voor toekomstige campagnes en begeleidt en werkt stagiairs in binnen het team.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt een passie voor influencer marketing en leeft social media. Je kijkt liever YouTube en TikTok dan televisie en denkt in Instagram Stories.
  • Je volgt de nieuwste features en ontwikkelingen op socialmediaplatformen en weet welke influencers op dit moment relevant zijn.
  • Je begrijpt hoe platformen als Face

Introductie 
 Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten?
 Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Product Manager die verantwoordelijk is voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.
 In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek.
 
 Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden 
 Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven.
 Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod

 Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen

 Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie

 Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group

 Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten

 Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio

 Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie

 Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal

 Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

 Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

 Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

 Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

 Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 About the role
 Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots.
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal.
  
 What you'll do
 Own positioning and messaging execution . Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations.

 Build and maintain competitive intelligence . Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns.

 Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences.

 Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback.

 Drive product launches and releases . Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers.

 Fuel demand and thought leadership . Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives.

 Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging.

  
 What you'll bring
 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories.

 Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features.

 Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments.

 A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts.

 Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence.

 Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base.

 Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers.

  
 What you'll get
 Category-defining work. Agentic process automation is being defined now, and you will shape how the market understands it.

 Real substance. 550+ enterprise customers and measurable outcomes mean your positioning rests on proof, not promises.

 Scope and access. You get a seat at the table with product, sales leadership, and the executive team, and your work goes straight into deals and board narratives.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, App o11y | Germany  | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Germany.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers. 

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences. 

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities 
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presenta

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Rail Integrations (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com . 
 We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.
 
 We are looking for a (Senior) Technical Product Manager, Rail Integrations, to join our Supply domain , more specifically in the Integrations team, which is responsible for onboarding carriers onto our system (integrating external systems, harmonising data structures and building revenue-increasing products for carriers). This is key to scaling our business; therefore, our focus is on innovation and automation. 
 
 What you will do: 
 Extend functionalities to enable new opportunities 

 Automate and innovate our existing inventory (our API product is already used by big players) 

 Own scoping and management of onboarding new carriers; establish wider scope throughout Asia 

 Take a lead role in defining and challenging strategic decisions 

 Contribute to the team with process improvements (e.g. Jira, reporting, etc.) 

 Build relationships with key stakeholders (internal/external – C-level) 
 

 Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid; or Remote 
 We are a remote-first international company with team members spread around the world. We are looking to hire the best talent around the Globe, so wherever you are, feel free to reach out. If, however, you prefer working onsite/hybrid, our heart is in Berlin, one of the biggest and most vibrant tech hubs in Europe, and we are happy to assist with relocation. 
 
 Who you are: 
 MUST HAVE: Rail industry experience. Hands-on experience with PICO API, OSDM, or other European rail carrier and transportation industry standards. 

 Product Management background: 4+ years of professional experience, with hands-on exposure to the technical side of the product (APIs / data products) — experience with complex products is a plus. 

 Stakeholder management: strong track record influencing without direct authority, including at C-level, while comfortably context-switching and showing proactivity and ownership across your responsibilities. 

 Management skills: solid grounding across product, process, project, and people management, developed within cross-functional teams. 

 Background: technical or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; fluent in English, both verbal and written. 

 
 Nice to have: 
 Ready to lead (experience is a plus) : you may have already managed a small team of technical PMs or analysts. If not, you're excited to start. You know how to coach, unblock, and grow people while staying close to the work 

 
 What you can expect: 
 Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide. 

 Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions. 

 Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions. 

 Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. 

 Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day. 

 Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow. 
 

 
 Our hiring process for this role: 
 For any questions, you can contact your Talent Partner (TP), Benedetta, at ( ).

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Colocation EMEA
jobs.description:
**Please note this position requires weekly travel to/attendance at project sites. Locations could vary across the Nordics and EMEA**

About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale are developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation.

Nscale are working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is an opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond.

Role Overview

The Senior Project Manager will play a leading role in managing the construction of Nscale’s data centre facilities, with a particular focus on fit-out / partnered projects. Reporting to the Project Director, this role may be sat across individual projects or multiple concurrently depending on scale and scope of project pipeline, and will be responsible for ensuring projects are delivered successfully by coordinating design, engineering, and construction activities through each stage of project execution.

You will manage scope, schedule, progress, quality, and risk, ensuring consistency with Nscale’s standards, governance, and delivery objectives.You will coordinate with internal team members and external partners to deliver on time, safely, and to specification.

You will maintain visibility of project budgets, forecasts, and reporting to ensure informed and proactive decision-making. Collaboration across internal teams — including Engineering, EH&S, Finance, and Operations — will be key to delivering world-class, sustainable infrastructure that supports Nscale’s AI mission.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead data centre project delivery from design through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

  • Manage project scope, schedule, and quality, ensuring alignment with design intent and business objectives.

  • Coordinate and lead discipline Project Management (MEP, CSA) when required and ensure all packages of work integrate smoothly.

  • Maintain oversight of project budgets and schedules in coordination with the Commercial Manager, reporting progress and highlighting key risks.

  • Work closely with Design for design reviews, approvals, and documentation control.

  • Collaborate with general contractors to assess and manage local construction capabilities, resource planning, and performance.

  • Drive adherence to program milestones, identifying potential delays and developing recovery plans.

  • Build and maintain a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance through active engagement and auditing.

  • Chair regular status meetings, issue reports, and maintain clear communication between stakeholders and leadership.

  • Support compliance with building codes and regulatory requirements, advising on design implications or alternative solutions.

  • Lead risk identification and resolution, ensuring issues are captured, tracked, and addressed early.

  • Work collaboratively with internal departments (Engineering, EH&S, Finance, Operations) to ensure seamless project delivery and transition to operations.

Experience & Qualifications Required

  • Over 8 years of experience managing large-scale, mission-critical construction projects, including expertise in data centre developments and fit-out works
  • Ideally you will have delivered projects integrating TCS loop liquid cooling networks
  • Degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-discipline delivery teams 
  • Strong knowledge of construction sequencing, scheduling, and coordination.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to lead effectively in fast-paced environments.
  • Proficiency in project management and reporting tools
  • Understanding of commercial and contractual principles sufficient to ensure alignment with cost and schedule targets

 

For information on how Nscale handles candidate persona
