jobs.title: (Senior) Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager based in France. 

 As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will take full ownership of product marketing strategy in a fast-growing, international AdTech environment. You will shape how innovative advertising technology products are positioned, communicated, and brought to market. Working closely with product, sales, customer success, and other cross-functional teams, you will translate complex technical capabilities into compelling value propositions. You will play a key role in developing go-to-market strategies, enabling commercial teams, and strengthening customer engagement. By combining market intelligence, customer insights, and data-driven storytelling, you will help drive business growth and product adoption. This is an opportunity to join a collaborative, remote-first team and contribute to the evolution of programmatic advertising across mobile and connected TV.

 Accountabilities 
 
 You will lead product marketing initiatives from strategy development to execution, ensuring consistent positioning and effective communication across customer-facing teams.

 
 
 Develop and execute product marketing strategies to promote products and solutions to existing and prospective B2B customers.

 
 Create compelling marketing content and bold narratives that clearly communicate product value, differentiation, and competitive advantages.

 
 Collaborate closely with product teams to ensure marketing messaging accurately reflects product features, capabilities, and developments.

 
 Lead go-to-market initiatives for new product launches and equip sales and customer success teams with effective messaging and enablement materials.

 
 Engage regularly with customers and internal stakeholders to collect feedback, understand market needs, and identify emerging industry trends.

 
 Partner with sales and customer success teams to align marketing execution with business objectives and customer insights.

 
 Monitor campaign and product marketing performance against key performance indicators, using data to identify opportunities for improvement.

 
 Leverage MarTech platforms and AI-powered tools to streamline content creation, improve reporting, optimize segmentation, and deliver personalized marketing experiences.

 
 Anticipate market developments and emerging advertising trends, translating them into relevant product positioning and forward-looking marketing narratives.

 Requirements :

 You are a proactive and strategic marketing professional with strong expertise in B2B advertising technology, excellent communication skills, and the ability to influence teams across a dynamic international organization.

 
 
 At least 5 years of experience in B2B AdTech, ideally within a startup or scaleup environment, with a proven track record in product marketing.

 
 Strong understanding of the programmatic advertising ecosystem, particularly mobile advertising trends, challenges, and opportunities.

 
 Solid knowledge of AI tools and demonstrated ability to integrate them into everyday marketing workflows.

 
 Experience with marketing platforms and tools such as HubSpot and WordPress is a plus.

 
 Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to develop engaging stories and compelling messaging for B2B audiences.

 
 Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data and insights into differentiated marketing narratives.

 
 Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

 
 Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

 
 Outstanding organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.

 
 Genuine passion for mobile marketing and app advertising, with a strong interest in emerging technologies and industry developments.

 
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, remote-first, and international environment.

 
 Proven ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional teams without formal authority, particularly across sales, customer success, and product management.

 Benefits :

 
 
 Exceptional opportunities for career growth and professional development.

 
 The opportunity to work alongside experienced industry experts and entrepreneurs shaping the future of AdTech.

 
 Direct, day-to-day collaboration with the leadership team.

 
 A fun, ambitious, and multinational team distributed across Europe, India, Argentina, and soon the United States.

 
 Flexible work-from-home arrangements.

 
 A $500 home-office setup budget.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Retail
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions.

Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us define and build purpose-built, highly differentiated shopping experiences across our growing portfolio of Retail categories.


What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Retail Categories team. Retail only wins category by category; a single, generic shopping experience cannot do justice to the unique ways people buy apparel, auto parts, or home improvement goods. This role owns the end-to-end category shopping experience for a defined portfolio, transforming broad customer promises into shipped surfaces and distinct emotional hooks that drive habitual buying behavior.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define Category Strategy: Formulate the category experience strategy and decide which categories and bets to invest in first, sequencing for maximum growth and impact.

  • Execute Signature Product Bets: Translate each category's promise into concrete, testable product bets—such as personal-shopper features using doorstep returns for Apparel or fitment-accurate part lookup for Auto Parts—and ship them end to end.

  • Optimise Category Surfaces: Own the category merchandising and storefront surfaces that differentiate one vertical from another while maintaining a cohesive and intuitive Retail experience.

  • Leverage Platform Capabilities: Partner with shared platform infrastructure (such as doorstep returns or fulfillment) to build bespoke category experiences without rebuilding core infrastructure.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply with BD, Sales, Catalog, and Search teams to ensure category surfaces are powered by accurate data and align cleanly with merchant relationships.

  • Measure Impact: Use data, customer insight, and experimentation to prioritise initiatives, define success metrics, and directly move the needle on conversion and repeat purchases.


What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Proven Consumer Product Experience: Demonstrated success in product management on consumer-facing products, ideally within e-commerce, marketplaces, or multi-sided platforms.

  • Track Record of 0-to-1 Innovation: Proven ability to ship brand-new or highly differentiated shopping experiences, navigating ambiguity to break broad opportunities into focused, testable bets.

  • Strong Analytical Capabilities: Comfort driving data-informed prioritisation, establishing robust success metrics, and utilising experimentation to measure category-level impact.

  • Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Experience partnering closely with cross-functional product teams (Engineering, Design, Analytics) as well as commercial teams like BD and Sales to align business needs with product strategy.

  • Customer-Obsessed Product Instinct: A natural intuition for customer behaviour, understanding what makes a shopping experience feel right and how to design the emotional hook that drives retention.

Nice to Have

  • Specialised Retail Domain Knowledge: Prior experience working with merchandising, category management, product detail pages (PDP), or specialised shopping flows.

  • Data Structure Familiarity: Experience working alongside Catalog or Search product areas to power front-end surfaces with complex item data.


Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale

Vilgain makes high-quality food - clean, functional ingredients, no shortcuts, no filler additives . 
 
 We're 700+ people across Prague, Brno and London, already selling in 12+ markets across Europe, the UK, the US and beyond. 
 We're on a mission to change how people think about food , and we're growing fast to do it - expanding internationally and building a company where people have a real say in what we make and how we make it, not just a seat at the table. 
 
 Your mission 🎯 
 You'll own specific product development projects from brief to launch, working directly with third-party suppliers and manufacturers. Working closely with the Category Manager, you'll make sure every project is aligned with the wider category goals and launch plan, and spot the commercial opportunities that will help the category grow. 
 
 What will you do? 
 Owning end-to-end new product development projects, from initial brief through development to market launch. 

 Running projects with third-party manufacturers – sourcing and selecting suppliers and managing those relationships day to day. 

 Reporting into the Category Manager and making sure your projects are aligned with the wider category goals and launch plan. 

 Building the commercial case for your projects – costings, margins and volumes – and prioritising the opportunities with the highest value. 

 Partnering with design, marketing, Regulatory and QA to bring products to market, including briefs, documentation and artwork sign-off. 

 Running existing product development (EPD) projects such as product improvements, packaging amends and label corrections. 

 Monitoring market trends and identifying new commercial opportunities for the category. 

 
 What do we expect from you? 
 At least 3 years' experience in NPD, project management or a similar role in the food industry – food experience is essential. 

 Experience with private label production and working with third-party manufacturers. 

 Highly numerate and financially aware, with the commercial sense to prioritise high-value opportunities. 

 Experience in a small business or startup environment – we move quickly, and you'll need to be happy with the fast pace of a rapidly growing business. 

 Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to juggle several projects at once. 

 A proactive problem-solver who takes initiative and can work independently. 

 A strong communicator who can build good relationships with colleagues, both internally and externally. 

 Confident with spreadsheets and project management tools, and actively uses AI tools to work smarter. 

 A love for food and a genuine interest in making a difference to the food system. 

 Fluent in English.
 

 What we offer: 
 Based in London, hybrid – minimum 3 days a week in the office. 

 Fast-paced, growing team where your work has a visible impact on the products we launch. 

 5 weeks of vacation, flexible hours, and remote work options, get monthly shopping credits. 

 Stay connected through team events, breakfasts, and group workouts.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

jobs.title: Product Manager Apprentice, Checkout
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.
 We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.
 Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. 
 Are you ready to join us?
 We are looking for a passionate and motivated Product Manager Apprentice to join our Customer Journey Team as part of the Checkout Squad.
  
 This apprenticeship offers a unique opportunity to improve our shopping funnel on web and app, ensuring it’s as seamless and delightful an experience as possible. You will do so by helping to run AB tests on the user interface to uncover the most impactful features.
  
 You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including other Product Managers in the customer teams, Operations, Engineering, Content and Design, to drive impactful product initiatives.
 
 YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 
 Support Product Development : Participate across the product lifecycle: solution ideation, prioritization, development, and launch.

 Handle Delivery Management : Write detailed specifications and user stories, oversee the implementation of features with IT engineers and perform quality assurance (QA).

 Autonomously run AB tests to optimize the conversion rate from product page to checkout. Scope the test, analyse and interpret the results to uncover the best solutions.

 Collaborate with Teams : Work closely with PMs, designers and marketing to challenge and prioritize feature requests, ensuring that our features are adopted seamlessly and add value to users (customers, sellers).

 Monitor performances: Ensure each feature’s performance can be measured, help estimate the impact and follow up the results post-launch.

 
 TOOLS YOU'LL USE: ⚒️
 Jira & Confluence: For Delivery management and Documentation

 Slack & Google Suite: For internal communications and meetings

 Amplitude Experiment and Analysis: for AB test setup and data analysis
 

 YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐
 You have an interest in product management and always put the user at the center of your thoughts.

 You have great analytical skills and a methodological approach.

 You possess effective and precise communication skills.

 You are curious, proactive, resourceful, and rigorous

 Team spirit is essential for you.

 You are fluent in spoken and written English, as we are an international team (MANDATORY).

 Big plus if you are already familiar with working with software developers, working across multiple teams or Agile concepts

 Big plus if you already have any experience in UX (user experience) or AB testing
 

 ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIP ℹ️ 
 Starting date: January 2027

 Duration: Ideally for 24 months (12 months to be discussed). 

 Location: Paris, France

 Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)

 
 RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅
 Product Sense Interview with Hiring Manager

 Team/Cultural fit interview with 1 other member of the team

 HR Interview with Campus Recruiter

 WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 
 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).
 No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:
 - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.
 - Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.
 - Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.
 At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Horizon Trading Solutions est une FinTech internationale indépendante, spécialisée dans les technologies de trading électronique multi-actifs depuis plus de 20 ans. Avec environ 160 collaborateurs répartis entre Paris, Rennes, Nantes, Montréal, Dubaï, Hong Kong, Bangkok et Singapour, nous accompagnons les institutions financières dans l'optimisation de leurs activités de trading grâce à des solutions technologiques innovantes.

Certifiée B Corp, Horizon s'engage en faveur d'une innovation responsable et a été récompensée à plusieurs reprises pour ses solutions, notamment avec le prix Best Sell-Side OMS 2025.

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire en automatisation et gestion de projet pour rejoindre notre équipe Client Delivery Management (CDM), dans le cadre d'un stage de 6 mois, avec un démarrage possible entre février et avril 2027.

Notre équipe CDM accompagne nos clients dans le déploiement, la personnalisation et l'évolution de notre plateforme de trading, de la connectivité API à la configuration des workflows de trading.

Dans une démarche d'amélioration continue, nous avons récemment déployé Rocketlane, une plateforme dédiée à la gestion de projets et à l'onboarding client.

Votre mission sera de développer des solutions d'automatisation, d'optimiser les processus existants et d'intégrer Rocketlane à nos outils internes, afin de simplifier le quotidien de nos chefs de projet, de fiabiliser le suivi des activités et de réduire les tâches répétitives.

Ce stage vous permettra d'évoluer à l'intersection de la technologie, de la gestion de projet et des marchés financiers, en participant à des projets concrets dans un environnement international.

Vos missions

  • Analyse et optimisation des processus : Étudier l'utilisation actuelle de Rocketlane et identifier les tâches manuelles pouvant être automatisées : création de projets à partir de modèles, relances, mises à jour de statuts et reporting.

  • Développement et automatisation : Concevoir et développer des scripts et des automatisations, notamment en Python, en exploitant les API et les webhooks de Rocketlane.

  • Intégration des outils : Améliorer l'interconnexion entre Rocketlane et nos outils internes (ticketing, support, documentation, annuaires clients) afin de limiter les doubles saisies et de fluidifier le partage d'informations.

  • Suivi et reporting : Contribuer à la création et à l'amélioration de tableaux de bord, d'indicateurs de performance et d'outils de suivi des projets.

  • Participation aux projets clients : Prendre part à des projets d'onboarding réels pour comprendre les besoins opérationnels, notamment les tests de connexion, la configuration des workflows de trading et la documentation.

  • Collaboration transverse : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Client Delivery, Développement, Support et Produit pour comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées.

Profil recherché

  • Tu prépares un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master 2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs) en informatique, ingénierie, finance ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Tu disposes de bonnes bases en programmation, idéalement en Python, et tu comprends le fonctionnement des API. Des connaissances en webhooks ou en outils d'automatisation sont un plus.

  • Tu es à l'aise aussi bien sur les aspects techniques (programmation, intégrations, automatisation) que fonctionnels (gestion de projet, processus métiers, besoins clients).

  • Tu maîtrises le français et l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, et tu es à l'aise pour communiquer dans un environnement international.

  • Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se), autonome et doté(e) d'un bon esprit analytique. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement des outils, identifier des pistes d'amélioration et proposer des solutions concrètes.

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés, techniques comme fonctionnels.

  • Tu t'intéresses aux nouvelles technologies et aux marchés financiers, et tu souhaites découvrir les enjeux du trading électronique dans un environnement FinTech.

 Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.
  
 Why Morpho Exists
 Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here .
 Location
 Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).
  
 Role
 Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work. 
 
 This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.
  
 Responsibilities
 Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

 Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

 Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

 Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

 Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

 Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

 Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

  
 What Success Looks Like
 First 30 days
 You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.
  
 First 3 months
 You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.
  
 First 6 months
 You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Engineering Delivery
jobs.description:
Diabolocom is looking for a Technical Project Manager to coordinate engineering delivery across our organization and work closely with the Head of Software Engineering on roadmap execution. 

 You will work across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to keep delivery on track, manage dependencies, identify risks early, and help turn delivery challenges into clear actions and decisions. 

 We are looking for someone with a software engineering background who has moved into technical leadership and genuinely enjoys the operational side of engineering. 

 The role 

 Our engineering organization includes around 90 engineers across 12 teams , working on a complex global product and multiple parallel initiatives. 

 This role combines ownership of our engineering delivery processes with hands-on execution . You will be responsible not only for running these processes, but also for continuously improving how we plan, coordinate and track delivery across the organization. 

 Process ownership 

 You will own and continuously improve: 

 
 engineering delivery planning processes 

 delivery tracking and reporting 

 cross-team coordination and dependency management. 

 
 You will build on our existing practices and ClickUp workflows, identifying what can work better and evolving the processes as the organization and product develop. 

 Delivery execution 

 Day to day, you will: 

 
 track delivery across teams and releases 

 coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across teams 

 identify risks, blockers and delivery gaps early 

 challenge unclear timelines, priorities and commitments 

 coordinate next steps when delivery is at risk 

 provide clear visibility on delivery status and progress. 

 
 You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to facilitate alignment. 

 The objective is simple: make software delivery predictable, transparent and effective . 

 What success looks like 

 First few weeks: You start taking ownership of delivery operations and become effective in coordinating ongoing delivery. 

 Within ~6-8 weeks: You understand the roadmap, teams, dependencies and delivery processes well enough to manage them confidently and start identifying opportunities for improvement. 

 Within 3 months: You operate autonomously across day-to-day engineering delivery coordination, bringing in the Head of Software Engineering when decisions or trade-offs require escalation. 

 Your work will directly influence our delivery efficiency and predictability : how much we can take on and how reliably we deliver what we commit to. 

 Who we are looking for 

 We are looking for someone who started in software engineering and moved into technical leadership , for example, an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, senior Team Lead, or Technical Program Manager. 

 Titles matter less than scope. You need enough technical depth to understand architecture and dependencies, ask the right questions, and navigate complex delivery problems across teams. 

 We expect 

 
 around 10 years of experience in software engineering environments 

 at least 3 years in engineering or technical leadership 

 previous hands-on experience as a software engineer 

 experience leading or coordinating multiple engineering teams 

 a track record of delivering complex software initiatives and improving execution 

 strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, distributed systems and cross-team dependencies 

 understanding of Product Management fundamentals 

 experience with Agile and structured project management frameworks such as PMBOK or similar 

 strong prioritization, decision-making and communication skills 

 professional fluency in English . 

 
 French and Russian are nice to have. 

 This role will suit you if… 

 You still enjoy technical complexity , but what really motivates you is making execution work. 

 You like finding out why something is stuck and fixing it. 

 You genuinely enjoy the operational side of engineering: creating structure, improving processes, coordinating teams and making sure things get delivered. 

 You don’t just want to follow an established process. You naturally look for ways to make it work better. 

 You are comfortable working across multiple teams, asking difficult questions when needed, and bringing structure to situations where priorities, dependencies or timelines are not immediately clear. 

 Why Diabolocom 

 Diabolocom is building one of Europe’s most advanced AI-native CCaaS platforms , powering business-critical customer interactions for 400+ enterprise and mid-market customers across 60+ countries . 

 We combine a mature global CCaaS platform with a rapidly growing AI Product Suite , backed by our internal AI Research Lab and proprietary AI innovation. 

 Our ambition goes beyond adding AI features to an existing product. We are building toward a platform capable of orchestrating AI agents, human agents, business

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Data Lake (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Notre Team Data lake recherche un·e Senior Product Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : au travers du sport rendre le bien être accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client.

Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons notre futur.e Senior Product Manager pour rejoindre les équipes Data Factory.

Cette plateforme technologique, globale à tout le groupe de manière internationale, soutient le développement de l’usage de la Data et de l’IA chez Decathlon, du calcul du chiffre d’affaires à l’aide de conception de produits innovants.

Nous sommes garants des outils, de la scalabilité, de la mise en place et du respect des bonnes pratiques de développement. Nous accompagnons au quotidien l’ensemble des acteurs métiers tels que Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists.

La Data Factory est conçue comme une Modern Data Stack, avec un lakehouse comme centre de gravité.

Elle est ensuite divisée en plusieurs équipes, chacune étant pilotée par un leader technique, avec comme ambition de travailler avec un.e Product Manager attitré.e.

Notre équipe Data Lake est donc la brique fondamentale de cette mission.

Notre mission ? Mettre à disposition des solutions de stockage pour l’ensemble de la Data Platform de Decathlon, tout en garantissant la gouvernance, robustesse et scalabilité par défaut. Véritable pilier de la gouvernance technique du patrimoine de données, notre équipe gère les métadonnées via le metastore Unity Catalog et les data contracts, permettant ainsi de construire une observabilité globale de la plateforme (usage, lignage, etc.). Un terrain de jeu technique à fort impact et aux défis d'envergure internationale !

L'équipe est composée actuellement de :

  • 1 Product Manager
  • 1 Data Architect
  • 1 Data Engineer
  • 1 Software Engineer
  • 2 Ops Engineer

Exemples de challenges actuels :

  • Améliorer notre offre de support pour faciliter le parcours utilisateur (documentation, gestion des incidents, ...)
  • Discussion avec les équipes Data/IA des pays et domaines sur leurs challenges du moment (données sensibles, données privées, ...) pour définir les priorités de nos équipes
  • Comment faciliter la gouvernance des données ? Par exemple intégrer des règles automatiques de validation des données, data contractualization, ...
  • Rationalisation de notre offre et décommissionnement du legacy

 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Notre ambition groupe, celle d’améliorer l’expérience digitale de nos clients, nous amène à une nouvelle approche orientée clients, une approche produit.

Le/La Product Manager de l'équipe Data Lake:

  • Acquiert une compréhension de son périmètre, de l'état de l’art sur le marché, du fonctionnement technique des outils associés.
  • Représente nos utilisateurs métiers, comprend leurs challenges et les retranscrit aux équipes techniques.
  • Accompagne la mise en œuvre de nouvelles fonctionnalités ou produits sur tout le cycle de vie (démo, formation, communication, documentation, …).


Tu seras garant·e de l'évolution et de la robustesse de ce produit critique pour l'ensemble des équipes Decathlon.

Tes missions principales s'articuleront autour des axes suivants :

  • Vision & Delivery : Tu pilotes le cycle complet du produit, de la Discovery à la coordination du Delivery en lien étroit avec le Leader. Tu traduis les enjeux business et techniques en une roadmap claire, priorisée et axée sur la valeur.

  • Projets Stratégiques : Tu lead l'End-of-Life (EOL) de notre Legacy, orchestres la migration vers la nouvelle infrastructure et designs les nouveaux espaces et fonctionnalités sur Unity Catalog.

  • Gouvernance & Excell

jobs.title: Product Manager - Post Booking
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar 

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.
 

 Your Mission 

 As the Product Manager for Post-booking, you will shape the experience passengers have after making a booking, from managing their trips to getting the help they need before, during and after their journey.

 You will make post-booking a clear, reliable and useful part of the end-to-end BlaBlaCar experience across carpooling, bus and train. You will help passengers feel informed and in control, while reducing friction for our Customer Relationship Teams (CRT) and supporting the growth of our multimodal marketplace.

 You will co-lead the Post-booking squad with an Engineering Manager and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Relationship and our supply stakeholders.

 Your Responsibilities 

 Shape the post-booking vision and roadmap: Set a clear direction for the passenger experience after purchase, translating BlaBlaCar’s product strategy and business priorities into a focused roadmap. Take full responsibility for your scope, from strategy through execution.

 Improve the post-booking passenger experience: Identify opportunities to strengthen passenger satisfaction and trust by helping people find the information they need, manage their bookings and feel supported throughout their journey. You will lead the end-to-end product discoveries for those opportunities. 

 Optimize CRT contact rate: Partner with CRT teams to understand why passengers get in touch. Improve information on the platform and self-service so passengers can resolve issues with less effort. In particular, you will take over product leadership of our member-facing AI assistant.

 Use insights to guide decisions: Bring together customer feedback, product data and business context to identify opportunities, set priorities and evaluate impact using appropriate KPIs.

 Build alignment across teams: Act as the go-to product partner for Post-booking topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions and align leadership, Engineering, Design, CRT and other stakeholders.

 Your Qualifications 

 Experience : 3+ years in Product Management, ideally in a consumer marketplace, travel, mobility or another complex transactional product. Experience building products across markets, platforms or service types is a plus.

 Customer problem-solving: A track record of simplifying complex journeys and helping customers make confident decisions.

 Analytical approach : Comfortable combining product data, customer feedback and operational insights to identify problems, set priorities and measure results.

 Cross-functional influence : Able to bring Product, Engineering, Design, Operations and business stakeholders together around clear decisions and outcomes.

 Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory.

 If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application! 

 What we have to offer 

 2 to 3 days at the office per week

 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

 Financial support for home office equipment

 Minimum 25 days holiday per year

 Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

 Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

 Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like. 

 A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition.

 A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager.

 A Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders.

 A 30-minute video call with your engineering counterpart for final validation.

 Our hiring process lasts on average 20-25 days and offers usually come within 48 hours.
 BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the role 

 
 
 As Product Marketing Manager, you shape how the market understands our portfolio: positioning, differentiation and outside-in stories that turn complex legal tech into value buyers recognise, and that drive pipeline and revenue.

 
 
 
 Scope

 
 You'll join a small Product Marketing team within the global Marketing department. Your focus is the market narrative and making sure GTM teams use it. Product training, documentation and demo environments sit with our Enablement teams. Success means clarity in the market, consistent positioning, and GTM teams who tell our story well.

 
 
 
 Core responsibilities

 
 
 Foundational strategy

 
 Develop deep market and competitive insight. 

 Update and evolve ICPs, personas and use cases. 

 Inform product and GTM direction based on market opportunity and customer reality. 

 

 
 Positioning and messaging

 
 Apply positioning, differentiation and value propositions across all content and assets, internal and external. 

 Translate product capabilities into compelling, customer-centric narratives. 

 Shape the content and messaging frameworks that guide all customer-facing communication. 

 

 
 Operational impact

 
 Activate positioning across the GTM organization through launch alignment, messaging briefings and strategic field engagement. 

 Partner with Sales Enablement to embed messaging frameworks in the field. 

 Drive coherence across website, campaigns, launches and proof points. 

 Refine positioning using win/loss insights and market feedback. 

 Become a product expert: hold regular syncs with Product Managers on releases and roadmap, and turn each release into clear customer value. 

 

 
 AI and new ways of working

 
 Design, test and run AI-assisted PMM workflows, for example call and win/loss analysis, competitive monitoring and content review. 

 Document what works so the whole Marketing team can reuse it. 

 Bring new ideas on how we work, and test them quickly. 

 

 
 
 
 Who you work with

 
 Reports to: Senior Product Marketing Manager 

 Daily collaboration: Global Marketing team (10 people), Product Enablement, Sales Enablement, Customer Success Enablement 

 Key stakeholders: Product, Sales, Customer Success 

 
 
 
 
 What we're looking for

 
 3+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally in enterprise or complex software. 

 A proven track record shaping positioning, messaging and GTM strategy, not just executing it. 

 Cross-functional experience with Product, Sales and Customer Success teams. 

 Remote-first: you've built alignment across time zones without a shared office. 

 An analytical mindset: data is the foundation of most of our decisions. 

 Curious and hands-on with AI: you use it every day, like a colleague. We don't need an AI expert, but someone who enjoys testing new tools and building better ways of working with them. 

 Fluent English, written and spoken. 

 
 
 
 
 What really sets you apart

 Strategic thinker, decisive operator : you know when to challenge and when to ship. 

 Market-obsessed : you anticipate competitor moves and spot positioning gaps. 

 Exceptional storyteller : you simplify complexity without diluting substance. 

 Business-minded : you link your work to pipeline, win rates and deal velocity. 

 Builder with AI : you've already set up a new process, agent or workflow with AI and can show what changed. 

 Impact over output : you measure influence, not volume. 

 Strong opinions, loosely held : you defend your view with evidence and adjust when the market proves otherwise. 

 Problem solver with energy : you move problems forward at pace, even when they sit outside your job description. 

 Team player with range : you work easily with Product, Sales and CS, and adapt to what the team needs this week. 

 Out-of-the-box thinker : you question how things are done, propose new ways and test them. 

 
 
 
 Recruitment process

 1. Phone screening with Talent Acquisition 

 2. First interview with our Senior Product Marketing Manager 

 3. Case study 

 4. Team and stakeholder interviews, including our Global Head of Marketing 

 5. Final interview with our CEO or another key stakeholder

jobs.title: Product Manager – AI Agents & Atlassian Cloud
jobs.description:
You care about why people need a product and enjoy discovering how to make it more useful. At XALT, product work stays close to customer projects: at least half of your time is spent as a Product Owner or consultant on billable client work. What you learn there helps shape our own products.
 What we are working towards 
 We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on.
 What you will work on
 Develop product ideas for XALT Northstar, AI agents on Atlassian Cloud, developer experience and integrations such as CollabLayr.
 Investigate customer problems, prioritise requirements and turn them into clear product decisions.
 Work with engineering and consulting on prototypes, releases and learning from usage.
 Support delivery as a Product Owner or consultant for clients, with at least 50% billable time.
 What you bring
 Experience in software product management or product ownership and an interest in direct client work
 Understanding of cloud products, integrations and the possibilities of Rovo, Forge or MCP
 An AI prototype you built yourself , with benefits and limitations you can explain and demonstrate
 What we offer
 Unlimited tokens for Claude, OpenAI and the latest, most advanced AI tools
 €70,000–95,000 gross per year 
 Professional exchange within the team, across the Atlassian ecosystem as a Platinum Partner, and through the XALT AI Circle and IT Revolution
 Your working arrangements
 We value working together in the office: developing ideas, learning from one another and talking things through in person. Living in or around Munich or Leipzig is therefore a plus. Remote work is also possible. If you live further away, we would still love to hear from you. Together, we will discuss an arrangement that works for you, your team and the role.
 Our professional community
 Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. For our XALT AI Circle in Munich in autumn 2026, we have invited Peter Steinberger of the OpenClaw Foundation to discuss personal agents. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. For a closer look at our work, see Philipp’s talk from Charlotte.

 WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. 
 
 Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com .
 
 📐 About this role 
 This is a chance to help shape the next chapter of WRITER's product at a moment when generative AI is redefining how work gets done. As Lead product manager, you'll operate as a force-multiplier across the product organization — setting direction where it's unclear, aligning stakeholders, and making sure our most critical initiatives ship with excellence.
 
 You'll own ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces that span multiple product areas and teams, and you'll be equal parts strategist and operator. One moment you're shaping a multi-quarter roadmap; the next you're rolling up your sleeves to unblock execution. We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer empathy, technical depth, and business judgment — and who is energized by turning complex, evolving AI capabilities into products customers love.

 Drive high-impact product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and problem definition through launch, adoption, and iteration across areas that span multiple squads and surfaces

 Shape product strategy and roadmap in partnership with product leadership, translating company-level goals into clear, sequenced, ambitious bets

 Spend time with enterprise buyers, end users, and prospects to uncover unmet needs, validate problem-solution fit, and champion the customer voice in every decision

 Partner closely with engineering and design to define requirements, navigate technical tradeoffs, and build the right things in the right order, bringing real fluency to conversations about LLMs, agents, platform architecture, and data

 Align cross-functional stakeholders across go-to-market, sales, marketing, customer success, and executive leadership, communicating strategy and tradeoffs with crisp, audience-appropriate narrative

 Define and own success metrics for your areas, using data and qualitative signal to evaluate impact, course-correct, and tell the story of outcomes to leadership

 ⭐️ Is this you? 
 8+ years of product management experience with a track record of owning and shipping complex, high-impact products, ideally in SaaS, platform, infrastructure, or AI/ML-driven environments

About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Motorway 
 Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.
 This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.
 About the role 
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join Motorway's Product & Engineering team. Motorway is a UK online car-selling platform connecting private sellers with ~7,500 verified dealers through online auctions. You will own a problem area end to end, in either the seller or the dealer side of the marketplace, and be accountable for the outcomes you deliver.
 Building is cheaper than it has ever been. The hard part now is choosing the right thing to build. We want PMs with exceptional product sense who find the problems worth solving, back that judgement with evidence, and use the latest technology to solve them in ways that weren't possible a year ago.
 What you will do 
 Find the problems that matter 
 Identify the highest-impact problem areas by combining quantitative analysis with qualitative research, and explain clearly why they matter more than the alternatives

 See through the hundreds of good ideas to the few that will move the business and create real value for sellers and dealers

 Own outcome-based goals and metrics, not feature lists

 Build with AI, in your work and in our product 
 Use AI to make yourself and your team faster: automate routine PM tasks, analyse data and research quickly, and prototype or vibe code solutions to get customer feedback in days, not weeks

 Ask how each product could be built differently given what AI makes possible, and bring those ideas to your squad

 Make your team 2x more effective, not 2x busier

 Deliver with rigour 
 Lead a cross-functional squad of engineers, designers and data specialists from discovery through launch and measurement

 Run experiments that produce learning even when they fail, and act on what you learn

 Make clear trade-offs between customer needs, technical constraints and business priorities

 Bring people with you 
 Communicate the what, the why and the how clearly, through crisp, data-led documents and conversations

 Work with the people closest to you (engineering, design, data) and with execs and other business units such as Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Marketing

 Influence without authority and build alignment on difficult decisions

 Requirements 
 Proven experience as a product manager, with a track record of shipping products that moved meaningful business metrics, not just delivering features

 Strong product sense. You can show how you found and prioritised the right problem, and what you chose not to do

 Comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative evidence: you run user research and also query data, design experiments and interpret results yourself

 Data-oriented. You use data to understand problems, set goals and measure impact, and can debate approaches with data scientists and analysts

 AI-forward. You use AI tools regularly in your own work and have hands-on experience prototyping or building with them. You have a point of view on where AI helps and where it doesn't

 A clear, confident communicator who can work with engineers and analysts day to day and with senior leaders across the business

 Ability to move between detail and strategy without losing coherence

 Self-starter with strong ownership, a curious mindset, and the ability to build domain knowledge quickly

 Experience in marketplaces, consumer products or B2B platforms is helpful but not essential

 You're excited about changing how people buy and sell cars

 Benefits 
 We offer a fantastic range of benefits to help you thrive:
 Great work-life balance

 London office location with regular social events, office drinks and free snacks to keep you going

 Hybrid work schedule with 2 days per week in our Central London office

 Stock options so you can share in Motorway's growth and future success

 Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

 Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc

 Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including dental care and fitness discounts

 Cycle to work scheme, save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

 One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish

 Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave and workplace nursery scheme... and much more!

jobs.title: Product Manager, Context
jobs.description:
About Mistral 
 Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
 We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
 
 The Role 
 As a Product Manager on the Context team, you will define and build the foundation for how AI agents access, interact with, and leverage context, data, tools, platforms, and environments, to deliver powerful, scalable solutions. This role exists to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI capabilities and real-world usability, ensuring our agents are both capable and seamlessly integrated into Mistral’s broader product ecosystem.
 You’ll work at the intersection of engineering, research, design, and business, aligning stakeholders around a shared vision while driving execution from concept to launch. The impact of your work will shape how users and enterprises interact with AI, unlocking new possibilities for automation, intelligence, and efficiency.
 What You Will Do 
 Define and evangelize a clear product strategy for our Context & Search platform, aligning it with company goals and market opportunities.

 Lead market and UX research to identify unmet needs, competitive gaps, and emerging trends in enterprise AI.

 Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, balancing speed, quality, and user-centric design.

 Collaborate with design and research teams to create intuitive, high-impact user experiences, iteratively refined by data and feedback.

 Drive go-to-market efforts, including pricing, positioning, and adoption strategies, in partnership with marketing and sales.

 Align engineering, design, and business teams around priorities, trade-offs, and timelines to ensure seamless execution.

 Maintain a dynamic roadmap that delivers quick wins while advancing long-term strategic bets.

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of hands-on Product Management experience, preferably with a focus on Agentic AI, Context Engineering, Data platforms, MCP/Connectors, Search, Ontology and semantic layers in B2B/Enterprise environments.

 Strong technical fluency to navigate trade-offs and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.

 A relentless focus on solving real user problems, backed by data and qualitative insights.

 Proven ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams—engineering, design, and go-to-market—without direct authority.

 Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives for executives, teams, and users.

 Adaptability to thrive in dynamic environments where priorities shift rapidly.

 Low ego, high EQ, and a collaborative mindset to build trust and drive decisions through clarity.

 A builder’s mindset, with experience turning 0→1 ideas into products users love, and the autonomy to own outcomes end-to-end.

 
 What We Offer 
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
 For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page .

Als Ingenieurs- und Beratungsdienstleister sind wir weltweit in Projekten tätig, welche die Energiewende vorantreiben, den Schutz der Umwelt fördern und zur Verbesserung unser aller Lebensqualität beitragen. 
 Als Senior Project Manager BESS /m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Batteriespeicherprojekte in Deutschland und begleiten diese von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme. Zur Vertstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir engagierte Persönlichkeiten an verschiedenen Standorten deutschlandweit, die mir ihrer Expertise den Ausbau moderner Energiespeicherlösungen vorantreiben möchten.
 
 Aufgaben, die motivieren: 
 Projektmanagement von BESS-Projekten (Battery Energy Storage Systems) mit Schwerpunkt auf dem deutschen Markt

 Erfahrung mit den deutschen Genehmigungsanforderungen (z. B. BImSchG/BImSchV)

 Unterstützung der Beschaffung sowie Leitung von Ausschreibungs- und Vergabeverfahren

 Unterstützung während der Bau- und Inbetriebnahmephase

 Koordination von Nachunternehmern sowie Sicherstellung von QA/QC (Qualitätssicherung und Qualitätskontrolle)

 Qualifikationen, die überzeugen: 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien, Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

 6–8 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich elektrotechnischer Anlagen in Deutschland

 Erfahrung in der Planung von Anlagen im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien, Batteriespeichersystemen (BESS) oder anderen elektrotechnischen Anlagen in Deutschland

 Deutsch-, und Englischkenntnisse auf C1 Niveau

 Reisebreitschaft

 Sympathische Unternehmenskultur und gelebte V I e LF alt: Viele lokale aber auch überregionale Live-Events prägen unser Miteinander und der Großteil der Mitarbeitenden ist per "Du". Besonders stolz macht uns die Internationalität unseres Teams mit mehr als 30 unterschiedlichen Nationen.

Auch wenn es uns von anderen Unternehmen vielleicht nicht unterscheidet: Wir bieten freie Getränke, den obligatorischen Obstkorb und weitere Snacks für Zwischendurch inklusive Eis im Sommer.

Unsere Nachwuchskräfte treffen sich regelmäßig im Club der Jungingenieur:innen .

 Über das Gehalt hinaus: Wir beteiligen unsere Mitarbeitenden an Unternehmensgewinnen, honorieren Mitarbeiterempfehlungen sowie Fachartikel und -vorträge mit großzügigen Prämien und würdigen herausragende Projekte mit unseren Excellence Awards. jobs.title: Product Manager, Interactive Avatars (Staff/Principal-level)
jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 
 As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
 Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.
 
 About the role 
 For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back.
 We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there.
 It's early. Interactive Avatars is in closed beta today, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on.
 This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta.
  
 The problem you're solving 
 Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build.
 We have the avatar technology and a working beta. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny.
  
 What you'll be doing 
 Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles

 Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them

 Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves

 Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time

 Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job

 Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business

 Who you are 
 You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly.
 You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes.
 You care about the detail, and you can hold a quality bar for something subjective and hard: a real-time avatar either feels present and responsive or it feels off, and the difference lives in latency

jobs.title: Team Lead Manager - Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Mission:
 Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.
 Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.
 Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.
 Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.
 
 Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here .
 
 What We’re Looking For

 We’re looking for highly technical engineers who want to lead and manage one of our engineering teams. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans, and we’re now growing from 11 to more than 14 engineering teams in the coming months. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple.
  
 As a Team Lead Manager, you’ll lead a small team of engineers. You’ll set its technical direction, line-manage and grow the people in it, and stay hands-on in the code. This is not a hands-off management role: our teams are small, and you’ll be one of the strongest engineers on yours. You’ll partner closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer to decide what to build, and you’ll be accountable for how well it’s built and how fast it ships.
  
 If you’re a strong Tech Lead who hasn’t managed people yet, we’d still love to hear from you. You can start as a Team Lead, with management handled by an Engineering Manager, and grow into the full role with our support.
  
 What Can You Expect As a Team Lead Manager?

 Lead and Manage a Small Team. Line-manage the engineers on your team, run 1:1s, give feedback, and help them take on bigger problems.

 Stay Deeply Technical. You’ll still build. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time writing code, reviewing PRs, and unblocking the hardest technical problems.

 AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude, Code, and agentic workflows every day, and our product is built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. You’ll set the bar for how your team uses them.

 Customers at the Center. Talk directly with customers to understand their problems, and make sure your team builds things that create real value for them.

 Own Technical Direction. Make the architecture and design calls for your team’s problem space, and own the trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

 Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript across the stack, React, Postgres, and AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. Datadog, Meticulous, and Incident.io round it out.

 Shape the Roadmap. Work with your PM and Designer on prioritisation, scoping, and sequencing so the team ships what matters most.

 Build the Team. Interview, hire, and onboard new engineers as we double in size.

  
 About You

 You’re a highly technical full-stack engineer. You’ve designed and shipped web apps end to end in TypeScript, ideally on AWS serverless, and you’re still one of the strongest engineers in the room.

 You’ve led engineers. You’ve been a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or TLM, owning delivery and technical direction for a team.

 You want to manage people, or grow into it. Ideally, you’ve line-managed engineers already. If not, you’re keen to learn.

 You still love to build. Leading hasn’t pulled you away from the code, and you want a role where you keep shipping.

 You raise the bar. You know what well-architected, reliable software looks like, and you help others get there through reviews, pairing, and clear feedback.

 You’re motivated by customer impact. You care about outcomes for customers, not just output, and you make good calls on what to build and what to cut.

 You’re a strong partner. You work well with product and design, push back when it matters, and bring people with you.

 You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You can take an unclear problem, shape it, and get a team moving on it.

  
 Nice-to-Haves

 You’ve led a team through fast growt

jobs.title: Product Manager - CDI Paris - Theodo RetailTech
jobs.description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès 

 Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. 

 

 Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. 

 

 La practice RetailTech regroupe nos clients du retail et de l'e-commerce : des acteurs qui transforment l'expérience d'achat de millions d'utilisateurs, en magasin comme en ligne. Elle rassemble les équipes produit, tech et design qui les accompagnent au quotidien sur des programmes à fort enjeu business. 

 

 C'est un domaine en pleine structuration : on y construit la communauté produit, on outille le staffing, on anime les rituels collectifs (all-hands, dojos) et on contribue aux avant-ventes pour faire grandie le portefeuille. 
 

 Tes futures missions : 

 En tant que Product Manager , ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. 

 

 - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée , en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. 

 - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). 

 - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. 

 - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. 

 - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. 

 - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique , en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. 

 - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). 

 

 Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : 

 - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. 

 

 - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires . Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle , impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. 

 

 Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : 

 Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits . 

 

 Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. 

 

 Profil recherché : 

 - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur , entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client. 

 - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business , avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. 

 - Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance. 

 - Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins. 

 - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser , capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé. 
 Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? 

 L’environnement: 

 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités
